verdict.rationale: Shared docs and notes are a fair capability to ask of a work-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a native doc or note feature for creating or organizing shared documents alongside boards. Mentions of item 'updates', custom item views, and call summaries are adjacent features, not shared docs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
